dialogues.speaker: Palais Mermonia Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Court of Fontaine Latest News Update Announcement."

dialogues.speaker: Palais Mermonia Bulletin
dialogues.text: "Please review this bulletin carefully. If you have any queries, please direct them to the Gestionnaire on duty."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Event Notice
dialogues.text: "A number of leisure events will be taking place throughout Fontaine in the coming days, details of which are provided below."

dialogues.speaker: Event Notice
dialogues.text: "Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland: A platform for film lovers to enjoy themselves and discuss their shared passion for the silver screen."

dialogues.speaker: Event Notice
dialogues.text: "All-comers are welcome to attend this event, which is taking place to the west of Marcotte Station. For any queries, please contact Miss Lepine-Pauline or Miss Navia."

dialogues.speaker: Event Notice
dialogues.text: "This month's Murder Mystery Novels Fan Club, as organized by The Steambird Culture and Arts Section, will be going ahead as scheduled. Members are welcome to attend the third-floor meeting room of the paper's offices for lively literary discussions."

dialogues.speaker: Event Notice
dialogues.text: "The Iridescence Tour is now recruiting performers and taking theme suggestions for their autumn concert! Interested parties should contact the organizer, Mr. Dvorak."

dialogues.speaker: Event Notice
dialogues.text: "The Trial Court has arranged to hold its 333rd Legal Awareness Campaign at the Opera Epiclese. All citizens are warmly invited to attend."

dialogues.speaker: Subscribe
dialogues.text: "The 'Palais Mermonia Trial Court Gazette' is compiled by the Maison Gardiennage and contains important materials such as legal documents and case files."

dialogues.speaker: Subscribe
dialogues.text: "The paper is published on the 10th day of each month and is available to all citizens who subscribe."

dialogues.speaker: Lost and Found Notice
dialogues.text: "The following items have recently been handed in to the Palais Mermonia's lost and found."

dialogues.speaker: Lost and Found Notice
dialogues.text: "1. A gray handbag containing a work permit, contract, and Mora was found in the Court of Fontaine's Quartier Lyonnais."

dialogues.speaker: Lost and Found Notice
dialogues.text: "2. A Kamera and a bouquet of Rainbow Roses were found on the Navia Line aquabus. Regrettably, the Roses show signs of wilting, so the owner is advised to collect their property without further delay."

dialogues.speaker: Lost and Found Notice
dialogues.text: "3. A locked suitcase was found on a beach close to Marcotte Station. The suitcase is notably heavy and is decorated in what appear to be Natlanese patterns."

dialogues.speaker: Lost and Found Notice
dialogues.text: "4. A bird cage containing a squirrel was found in an office of the New Fontaine Research Institute. The squirrel appears to be in a stable condition, though it is evidently unhappy with its current situation..."

dialogues.speaker: Lost and Found Notice
dialogues.text: "...Due to concerns for its health, the squirrel has already been released from the cage. Should the owner wish to retrieve it, we would strongly recommend that they reassess its basic requirements and living conditions."

dialogues.speaker: Lost and Found Notice
dialogues.text: "Would the owners of the above items please contact the Palais Mermonia staff and provide proof of identification to retrieve their lost property."

dialogues.speaker: Judicial Statistics
dialogues.text: The Trial Court's Annual Judicial Statistics Report has been published.

dialogues.speaker: Judicial Statistics
dialogues.text: Contains an overview of various civil and criminal cases. If you require access to the report, please contact Officer Sedene of the Marechaussee Phantom.

dialogues.speaker: Public Service Announcement
dialogues.text: "Instances of illegal gambling have recently been uncovered in the Court of Fontaine. Citizens are urged to be on the lookout. If you come across information that may be of help, please contact the Maison Gardiennage immediately."

dialogues.speaker: Public Service Announcement
dialogues.text: "Once again, citizens are reminded to be vigilant and to obey all pertinent rules and regulations. Make sure to protect yourselves and your property."
